Helicopter Crashes Kill Four in Brazil, Two in US Wildfire Fight

Two separate helicopter crashes have resulted in fatalities. In Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, a helicopter crashed in the Tijuca National Park, killing four people, including three Colombian tourists. Another helicopter crashed in Utah, USA, while fighting wildfires, killing its pilot and crew member. A separate incident in Utah also saw two people killed when a helicopter crashed during wildfire suppression efforts.
